banner.label: Analytics consent
banner.title: A word about analytics
banner.body: We would like to measure how OpenCartable is used so we can improve it. Nothing is measured without your agreement, and you can change your mind at any time from the footer.

essential.title: Required to work
essential.body: Your theme, your language, your answer drafts and your session are kept in your browser, with no cookie and without being sent to a third party. This storage cannot be turned off.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: PostHog, hosted in the European Union, receives your page views, your clicks, loading times, the errors you hit and usage events (course created, course viewed, exercise attempted). A measurement cookie lets it recognise your repeat visits. Your share links, what you type and your exchanges with the AI are never part of it.

replay.title: Session recording
replay.body: Replays your navigation to help us understand where you got stuck. Input fields, AI answers and model answers are always masked, and shared course pages are never recorded.
